jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

This 100%onsite role, serves as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.

 **Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.

 **Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.

 **Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.

 **Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

 **BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk

 **COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

 *This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

  

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non\-monetary compensation which may be included.*

Please include the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line of the email. You may also mail your resume and cover letter to: Municipal Pooling Authority 1200 Concord Avenue, Suite 100, Concord, CA 94520

**About the Municipal Pooling Authority**

The Municipal Pooling Authority (MPA) is a well\-established and reputable Joint Powers Authority (JPA) established in 1977, to pool municipal assets to provide General Liability coverage and Workers' Compensation coverage for 21 municipalities in Northern California. MPA has grown to include Property, Vehicle Physical Damage, short\-term and long\-term disability, Risk Management, Ergonomics, Employee Benefits, and Employee Wellness services/programs. MPA provides in\-house administration of claims for General Liability, Workers' Compensation, and Vehicle programs, and claims administration services are maintained through Origami, an online claims management system. MPA has continually received Accreditation with Excellence from the California Association of Joint Powers Authorities CAJPA).

Join our team and enjoy MPA’s comprehensive benefits package and defined benefit retirement plan through CalPERS. Some of the benefits package highlights include no\-cost dental and vision coverage for the employee and family, and for medical, there is a minimal employee contribution for Kaiser of $55\.00, with other plans available for an increased share of the cost. MPA provides 14 paid holidays a year, 12 sick days a year, one administration day a year (increasing up to 5 days based on years of service, and 12 days of vacation (increasing based on years of service), and may work remotely up to 4 days a week.

The MPA team has 26 employees who specialize in their area of work, from public administration requirements of pooling to claims administration and program management. The MPA team is a highly collaborative team that takes pride in their area of work and often works together to strategize on moving MPA forward. The team enjoys quarterly team\-building events.

jobs.title: Bike Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**  

As a CBRE BikeProgram Coordinator, you will support the bike program in Mountain View andassist with the implementation of employee commute and transportation programs.
  
This position ispart of the Transportation team, which promotes alternative commuting optionsand helps reduce single\-occupancy vehicle usage through biking, walking,ridesharing, transit, and other mobility solutions.
  
This position isonsite five days per week.
  
**What You'll Do:** Rebalance campus bikes throughout the day to ensure availability across all buildings. Unlock all campus bikes in the morning and secure them at the end of the day. Recover campus bikes from offsite locations as needed. Assist with bike upkeep, including cleaning, replacing bike number decals, and identifying bikes that require servicing. Support the loaner bike program, including bike sizing, helmet fitting, and rider education. Assist with bike\-related events and classes, including Bike to Work Day, demo events, and educational sessions. Support the development and implementation of programs that encourage a biking culture across campus. Support tours, education sessions, and other transportation\-related activities. Follow all transportation, workplace, and safety procedures. Complete additional duties as assigned.
  
  

**What You'll Need:** High School Diploma or GED required. 1\-2 years of transportation\-related experience required. Prior bike shop experience preferred. Experience with bike sizing and basic bike fitting. General understanding of bicycle mechanics and functionality. Ability to identify bicycles in need of maintenance or repair. Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions. Valid driver's license required. Ability to lift up to 40 lbs. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills. Comfortable interacting with employees, visitors, and large groups. Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office products and Google Workspace. Strong organizational and time\-management abilities. Ability to multitask and work effectively under pressure. Strong problem\-solving skills and adaptability. Ability to work flexible schedules based on business needs. Ability to support operational activities when needed.

When you joinCBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate servicesand investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problemsolvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact.
  
Our collaborativeculture is built on our shared values of respect, integrity, service, andexcellence. We value diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences andprovide opportunities for professional growth and development.
  
Our Values in Hiring
  
At CBRE, we arecommitted to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We valuediverse perspectives and experiences and welcome applications from allqualified candidates.

We value humaninteraction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills, andaspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiringdecisions, and we ask candidates to disclose any use of AI during theapplication and interview process.
  
Disclaimers
  
Applicants mustbe currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visasponsorship now or in the future.
  
  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Bike Program Coordinator position is $60,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Bike Program Coordinator position is $60,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. jobs.title: Customer Experience Center Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Applies professional human resources knowledge, organizational policies, procedures, and established practices to provide guidance to employees, supervisors, and managers and resolve a variety of human resources issues of moderate scope and complexity. Serves as a lead resource within the Customer Experience Center (CEC), providing day\-to\-day operational support, guidance, and subject matter expertise to CEC team members while helping ensure consistent, accurate, and timely delivery of HR services.


Provides direct customer support through multiple service channels, including the Genesys phone line, Oracle Help Desk inquiry cases, shared email box(es), and more. The incumbent will be logged into the phone line daily and respond to a broad range of HR questions spanning HR subunits, as well as research and respond to voicemails, emails, chats, and cases. Independently researches issues, identifies appropriate resources and solutions, and escalates complex, sensitive, or urgent matters to the appropriate HR contact, team, or leadership as needed.


In the lead capacity, serves as a first point of consultation for CEC team members regarding more complex inquiries, processes, procedures, and appropriate escalation pathways. Provides guidance on case handling and customer service practices, supports onboarding and training of new and existing team members, shares knowledge and best practices, and assists with maintaining consistency in responses across service channels. May assist the Customer Experience Supervisor with coordinating daily workflow, identifying coverage or workload needs, communicating operational priorities, and supporting the team during periods of increased volume or emerging HR activity. The Lead may provide input and feedback regarding processes, service trends, training needs, and opportunities for team development.


Reporting to the Customer Experience Supervisor, the incumbent monitors inquiry trends and identifies high\-volume, recurring, or emerging areas of customer need. Partners with the supervisor, CEC team members, and HR subject matter experts to develop, review, and maintain knowledge content, response templates, job aids, and other resources that promote accurate and consistent responses and increase opportunities for employee and manager self\-service.

Helps translate this information into actionable guidance for the CEC team and supports readiness and consistent service delivery during these periods.

Responsibilities associated with such assignments may include coordinating or completing transactions, processing and amending forms, reviewing information for accuracy and completeness, interfacing with vendors and HR partners, troubleshooting issues, maintaining documentation, tracking work through completion, and serving as a resource to other CEC team members.


The incumbent also supports continuous improvement of CEC operations by identifying service gaps, recurring issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve the employee and manager experience. Participates in or leads assigned operational projects and process improvements, assists with testing or implementation of new procedures and tools, and communicates changes and recommended practices to the CEC team. Members really do come first at Stanford FCU because we’re non\-profit and owned by our members. Our members work for Stanford University or some of the most innovative companies in Silicon Valley—and we provide them with the most generous financial benefits in our industry.


Stanford FCU is a $4\.5 billion company with a global reach of over 95,000 members in 90 countries and growing! Come grow with us and see what it’s like to work for a Bay Area Top Workplace. As our CEO says, “we work hard, and we play hard”, and we need *your* help to improve even more financial lives!


The Lending Operations Business Analyst will partner with the Lending Product Manager to enhance lending platforms, streamline operations, and execute the product roadmap. Collaborate with business lines to gather requirements, solve complex system challenges, and support platform improvements. Conduct testing to validate system changes and ensure successful implementation. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem\-solver who continuously develops technical expertise, exercises sound judgment, and thrives in a collaborative, team\-oriented environment.


\*Please note this position is hybrid on site in Palo Alto, CA\*

* One to three years of industry experience and or combination of education and experience.
* Possess an understanding of current legal and regulatory issues: Reg Z, TRID, HMDA, Reg B.
* Willing to Learn and cross\-train departmental duties of the credit union. Possess versatility and flexibility to successfully serve as a backup to other positions.
* Knowledge in configuration Industry Lending platforms and familiarity with SQL and general understanding of relational database design.
* Ability to read and to interpret lending data.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
**What YOU’LL do:**

* Supports lending operations with issues and system enhancements.
* Configures platforms and maintains current knowledge of systems capabilities and emerging features.
* Testing and maintaining lending platforms.
* Produce ad hoc lending reports and end of month reports.
* Conduct Portfolio risk analysis.
* Produce and maintain Lending Systems departmental procedures.
 **Some of our benefits for YOU:**

* 100% paid employee medical, dental, vision, life/AD\&D and short\-term disability insurance for the employee; 50% paid for dependents
* Quarterly incentives up to 10% of your salary (based on position)
* Employer 401(k) matching up to 5% plus additional annual discretionary contributions

* Employee recognition program with cash incentives
* Commuter Toll Benefit $100\-$200/month (based on position)
* Wellness Benefits up to $1,200 per year
* Paid Sick Time accrues at two weeks per year
* Paid Vacation Time accrues at three weeks per year
* Paid Federal banking holidays (approximately 11 per year)
* Ongoing training and education, seminars, and conferences
* Loan rate discounts on some products (vehicle, mortgage and HELOC loans)
* Waived fees and deposit bonuses on Stanford FCU accounts
* Flex health/transit plan availability

If you are ready for this awesome opportunity (or know somebody who is) please contact us today!


Stanford Federal Credit Union provides competitive pay ranges based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities, qualifications needed for the position and external market pay for comparable positions.

We are looking for a Supply Chain Operations Manager within Low Voltage Electronics team to drive cutting edge technologies across all our vehicles and deliver results in a highly innovative and fast paced environment. This position will focus on mapping all component material flows globally for each active project working with external vendors and internal partners, develop robust material pipelining strategies across multiple products and vendors to mitigate E\&O and ensure supply availability. In addition, the person may lead Cost and Capex tracking across all components, programs and vendors within the value chain. An ideal candidate will have high ambition to grow within Tesla and bring high energy/impact to succeed in a fast\-paced environment. Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate through ambiguities/difficult obstacles through collection of facts \& data, advanced planning, evaluation of alternatives, open\-mindedness, thought\-through strategy, and superior communications to lead cross\-functional organizations through sourcing activities.  

**What You'll Do*** Own the Supplier Operations function within the Low Voltage Electronics Supply Chain team, maximizing component supply availability at optimal cost
* Manage material availability, readiness, and visibility across all in\-production programs from development and production ramp through End of Life and Service
* Develop and maintain a Material Drive strategy to ensure appropriate buffer and flexibility at the component level, enabling quick response to demand changes
* Drive cross\-functional alignment on PRQ priorities and material allocation across sites and programs to optimize supply chain efficiency
* Create dashboards and action plans to resolve material shortages in collaboration with GSMs, Vendors, Planning, and SIE teams
* Manage execution with external partners — including component vendors, contract manufacturers, and distributors — serving as the escalation point for urgent and critical issues

**What You'll Bring*** 5\+ years of experience in Supply Chain hardware operations within a fast\-paced, high\-volume industry
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills to manage complexity across multiple manufacturing sites, SKU mixes, and multi\-tier Supply Chain management
* Proven experience managing high\-volume hardware component product launches, delivery, and on\-time execution
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships and drive alignment and collaboration with cross\-functional teams internally and externally, including Engineering and Product Management, to optimize technical specifications and feature vs. value trade\-offs
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including presenting to management and teammates periodically
* Experience developing cost data, models, and analytics independently or partnering with IT teams to design and scale tools and systems for efficiency improvement
* Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Office Operations Manager
jobs.description:

You’ll work from our brand\-new offices in the heart of Silicon Valley, alongside a young, energetic team. This is a chance to be closely involved in high\-end homebuilding projects, work with premium customers, and grow with a company expanding into residential and commercial development.

**What you’ll do**

* Run daily office operations and keep schedules, communications, and records organized.
* Welcome customers and visitors, answer inquiries, and follow up with prospective clients.
* Keep customers informed about project progress, next steps, and important updates.
* Call city departments to follow up on permits, inspections, applications, and requirements.
* Coordinate with vendors, subcontractors, and our internal team to keep work moving.
* Support proposals, contracts, customer documents, invoices, and payment follow\-ups.
* Spot missing information or delays, take initiative, and follow through to resolution.

jobs.description:
**Location**

Must be based in the United States.


**About Nen Creative**
----------------------


Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.


Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.


We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Creative Operations Manager** to own staffing, capacity planning, and resource operations across our creative studio.


You'll work closely with Creative Producers, creative leads, and company leadership to make sure every project has the right team in place at the right time. You'll maintain a clear view across active and upcoming work, identify capacity constraints and scheduling conflicts, and help the studio make better staffing decisions as priorities shift.


A major part of this role is resource management, but you'll also help improve the systems and workflows behind how our studio operates. As we grow, you'll identify where our processes are breaking down and build better ways to plan, staff, track, and coordinate creative work.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and excited by both solving today's scheduling problems and building better systems for tomorrow.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Resource \& Capacity Management**

* Own resource planning across all active and upcoming creative projects
* Maintain a clear, up\-to\-date view of team availability, workload, project schedules, and upcoming capacity
* Identify capacity gaps, scheduling conflicts, and potential bottlenecks before they become problems
* Track utilization and help leadership understand where the team is over\- or under\-capacity
* Anticipate future resource needs based on the studio's pipeline and upcoming work

### **Project Staffing \& Scheduling**

* Match projects with the right internal team members based on skills, experience, availability, and project needs
* Partner with Creative Producers and creative leads to understand staffing needs and build the right project teams
* Support staffing for new business opportunities and incoming projects before work kicks off
* Manage staffing changes as project scopes, timelines, and priorities shift
* Coordinate internal staffing across shoots and maintain visibility into the studio\-wide shoot calendar

### **Creative Operations \& Systems**

* Build and maintain the systems, trackers, and dashboards used for resource and project planning
* Improve how projects are planned, staffed, kicked off, tracked, and handed off across the studio
* Identify recurring bottlenecks or operational issues and develop practical solutions
* Create clearer, more consistent processes for Creative Producers and creative teams
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and reduce unnecessary coordination
* Help leadership understand the operational impact of upcoming work before commitments are made

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in creative operations, resource management, project coordination, creative production, or a related field
* Strong understanding of creative production workflows, including pre\-production, shoot execution, and post\-production
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
* Naturally proactive — you see potential problems before someone has to point them out
* Strong people skills and the ability to build trust with creatives, project leads, and leadership
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and constantly changing timelines
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Able to make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information
* Resourceful, persistent, and comfortable working without a rigid playbook
* Comfortable with spreadsheets, project management tools, and quick to learn new systems
* Naturally interested in finding better ways for teams to work

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Play a central role in how a fast\-growing creative studio operates
* Work across a wide range of production projects for ambitious technology companies
* Help build the staffing, planning, and operational systems the company will use as it scales
* Work closely with Creative Producers, creative leadership, and company leadership
* Take ownership of an important function with visibility across the entire studio
* Remote\-friendly, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment
* Healthcare coverage, PTO, and company holidays

**About California Climate Action Corps (CCAC)**
------------------------------------------------


California Climate Action Corps (CCAC), a state service program led by California Volunteers, Office of the Governor, and implemented by Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), mobilizes emerging leaders to take direct climate action in communities across California. With over 400 fellows and 100\+ host partners, CCAC supports impactful service projects focused on urban greening, organic waste and edible food recovery, wildfire resiliency, and climate education and volunteer engagement. The program is rooted in service, equity, and sustainability.

### **Position Summary**


The Regional Supervisor – Operations \& Onboarding is a dynamic, multifaceted role responsible for both regional fellowship support and critical program operations for the California Climate Action Corps (CCAC). Approximately half of the role focuses on serving as a Regional Supervisor for a cohort of Fellows and Host Partners, while the other half focuses on owning key administrative, financial, compliance, and operational processes that support a 400\+ Fellow, 100\+ Host Partner Fellowship.


As a Regional Supervisor, this position serves as a primary program liaison across multiple Host Partner sites, providing ongoing support to Fellows and their Site Supervisors, conducting monthly virtual check\-ins and bi\-annual in\-person visits, supporting professional development, and helping ensure a successful Fellowship experience. On the operations side, this position will own high\-volume, detail\-oriented processes including timecard administration, reimbursements, financial reporting, and offer support for onboarding and offboarding, compliance tracking, and audits.

  

This role requires someone who can zoom in on the details while keeping the big picture in view. The ideal candidate is a proactive and organized self\-starter who takes ownership of complex processes, effectively manages competing priorities, and thrives in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

------------------------

* Own and manage the fellowship timecard approval process and reporting for 400\+ fellows, including reviewing, tracking, and resolving timecard issues
* Manage fellowship reimbursements, review documentation for accuracy and compliance, and coordinate timely processing
* Organize, prepare, and submit financial reports, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted by required deadlines
* Coordinate key onboarding and offboarding processes for 400\+ fellows annually
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems and processes, taking initiative to create greater consistency, efficiency, and accountability
* Support program audits by maintaining organized records, gathering documentation, and responding to requests

### **Fellow Regional Supervision**

* Act as Regional Supervisor for fellows and host partners, meeting virtually on a monthly basis and occasionally conducting in\-person site visits
* Collect all member evaluation and metrics reporting documentation
* Oversee and approve AmeriCorps timesheets, track AmeriCorps hours, and support fellow professional development and post\-fellowship transition

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree and 3\+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
	+ Program or operations administration
	+ Finance, financial administration, or grant administration
	+ Compliance, reporting, or audit support
	+ Onboarding or human resources support
	+ Stakeholder or partnership coordination
	+ Nonprofit, AmeriCorps, or other service\-oriented programs
* A highly organized, detail\-oriented self\-starter who can take ownership of complex processes from start to finish, manage high\-volume work and competing priorities, and maintain accuracy across multiple systems
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate challenging conversations, balance competing needs, and follow through
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to provide guidance and support to Fellows, Host Partners, and internal team members

Location: South Bay/Silicon Valley/San Jose area

Send your resume and a brief message telling us why you’d be a great fit to hello@pawsandclaws.pet.

Applications are reviewed by real people (no bots here!). If it looks like it could be a good fit, we’ll respond within 3\-5 business days. If selected, the process includes a questionnaire, two video interviews, and a reference check.

We can’t wait to meet you!

jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**


We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to own our deal desk function and lead the implementation, management, and ongoing optimization of our CPQ. This role sits at the intersection of pricing strategy, sales enablement, and systems ownership. You’ll be the Revenue Operations partner for Account Executives navigating complex, technical deals, while also building the infrastructure that lets the sales org quote and close faster.


We're specifically looking for someone who has experience setting defensible prices with novel deal structures with limited comps in a dynamic market. Our is a technical, consultative sale, where deal complexity, competitive dynamics, dynamic pricing make "one price fits all" impossible.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* ***Deal Desk \& Pricing Strategy***


	+ Advise AEs on deal structuring, negotiation tactics, and creative packaging to protect margin while removing friction to close. Serve as the primary point of contact for AEs on non\-standard deals, terms, pricing, and discounting.
	+ Set and continuously adjust pricing in response to a dynamic market, translating fast\-moving conditions into clear, real\-time pricing guidance for the GTM , product, and Finance teams.
	+ Conduct ongoing market rate analysis leveraging any competitor pricing intelligence, internal win/loss data, and segment\-level price sensitivity to recalibrate price points, discounts, and approval thresholds
	+ Own the deal approval workflow, ensuring the deals get the right level of scrutiny without becoming a bottleneck. Partner with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Legal on exception approvals, non\-standard terms, and contract structuring
	+ Track deal desk metrics: discount trends, approval cycle time, win rates by deal type, price realization. Build dashboards and reporting to give leadership visibility into pricing trends and deal desk throughput.**CPQ Ownership**


	+ Own end\-to\-end implementation, configuration, and maintenance of the CPQ system
	+ Build and maintain product bundles, pricing rules, discount schedules, approval matrices, and quote templates. Continuously audit CPQ data integrity (product catalog, price books, rules logic) to ensure quotes reflect our latest pricing strategy.
	+ Partner with Sales, Finance, and Product on new product launches, packaging changes, and price book updates, translating them into CPQ configuration
	+ Identify and eliminate friction in the quote\-to\-cash process. Reduce quote turnaround time and manual workarounds
	+ Train, enable, and support AEs and sales managers on CPQ best practices.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 4\-7 years of experience in Revenue Operations focusing on running a deal desk function, advising AEs on deal structuring, pricing strategy, and contract negotiations, preferably within a high growth, B2B technology environment.
* Proven track record setting and adjusting prices in a dynamic, fast\-moving market. Strong understanding of market rate benchmarking and competitive pricing analysis. Experience pricing usage\-based and consumption\-based products
* Hands\-on CPQ implementation and administration experience (Salesforce CPQ, DealHub, PandaDoc, Zuora, or similar)
* Strong Excel/Sheets modeling skills for pricing analysis; SQL or reporting tool experience a plus
* Experience at a growth\-stage company where you've had to build or rebuild processes from scratch

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with hyperscalers, GPU clouds, or high\-performance compute environments.
* Familiarity with large\-scale AI training and inference architectures.
* Strong network in the AI/ML and enterprise technology ecosystem.
* Track record of working with Fortune 500 enterprises and digitally native businesses on transformative infrastructure deals.

The department has a continuous stream of staffing and academic activity that requires the ability to work in partnership with Human Resources Shared Services and the Office of Faculty and Academic Affairs, with expertise in recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, leaves of absence, recognition, HR Oracle transaction processing, and other related areas.


Additional responsibilities include providing executive and senior leadership with HR/Academic Affairs strategic consultation, assigning HR\-related project management goals, providing high\-level data reporting, and independently executing all newly assigned duties as directed by the Chief Administrative Officer and department Chair. Also, provides ongoing strategic policy and operational process consultation. Provides triage consultation to executive leadership and advises management on complex performance management, disciplinary actions, union grievances, and internal investigations. This position will manage these HR\-related matters and play a critical leadership role in ensuring the department's workforce is highly skilled, compliant, productive, and motivated.


The predominant focus of this position is the performance of administrative operations activities; performs short\- and long\-term planning for the department. Regularly works on highly complex issues in which multiple situations or data require an in\-depth evaluation of multiple variables. Exercises sound judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Erroneous decisions or failure to achieve goals may result in additional costs and negatively impact departmental operations and employee morale.


**Department Overview**


The Department of Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery is a clinical department at UCSF that combines superior resident and medical student training with the highest\-quality patient care. Beyond our offices, clinics, and laboratories within the 107\-acre UCSF Parnassus campus above Golden Gate Park, our department reaches into the Moffitt Long Hospital, the Ambulatory Care Center, the Medical Center at Mount Zion, and shares UCSF’s partnerships with Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (SFVAMC).


Divisions within OHNS include Pediatric Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, Laryngology, Otology/Neurotology, Rhinology, Minimally Invasive Skull\-Based Surgery, Facial Plastic Surgery, and Sleep Disorders. The department ranked \#1 in Northern California by U.S. News \& World Report in 2021 and \#5 in the nation. We also have a robust research enterprise with 10 PhD faculty and a $10M sponsored research budget for FY26\. OHNS has consistently been ranked in the top 10 institutions for NIH funding. The department has an ACGME\-accredited residency program with 25 residents. Additionally, four fellows receive subspecialty training annually.


  
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience / training
* Minimum of five years of related work experience
* Advanced interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills
* Advanced knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as event planning, basic fundraising processes, risk management planning, website design, accounting and payroll, and contracts and grants regulations and guidelines
* Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality
* Advanced skills in short\- and long\-term strategic planning, analysis, problem\-solving and customer service
* Advanced knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques, and / or human resources policies and procedures for staff and academic employees
* Ability to work independently, conduct benchmarking, wage \& benefit analysis and derive recommendations to senior leadership
* Ability to work collaboratively with external teams in HR Shared Services, Labor \& Employee Relations, union representatives, and legal counsel
  

**Peferred Qualifications:**

* Human Resources professional certification

* Advanced knowledge of common University\-specific computer application programs

Project Manager Surgical Imaging

Cision Vision \| San Mateo, California \| Full\-time or substantial part\-time

Cision Vision is a MIT spinoff company developing cutting\-edge real\-time, label\-free optical imaging to help surgeons visualize critical anatomy. We are seeking a technically fluent project manager to drive its development across hardware, software, clinical input, quality, and external partners.

The opportunity

Working directly with company and engineering leadership, you will take the surgical imaging program from technological concepts toward a product\-ready system. You will build a credible plan, connect subsystem teams, drive decisions, and make sure progress is demonstrated by working hardware and software and supported by clear documentation. This role calls for someone who can lead through influence and get into the details when needed. Occasional travel to clinical study partners and collaborators is expected.

Responsibilities

* Own an integrated development plan with measurable milestones, owners, dependencies, resources, budget, critical path, and readiness criteria, from requirements and prototype builds through verification and design transfer.
* Coordinate optics and illumination, camera electronics, mechanical engineering, firmware, software, AI, and system integration. Keep subsystem interfaces, build plans, test results, and clinical feedback connected.
* Lead focused technical and program reviews. Identify integration and schedule risks early, drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions, remove blockers, and follow through on commitments.
* Work with systems, quality, and regulatory colleagues on requirements traceability, design controls, risk management, change control, verification and validation plans, and documented milestone evidence.
* Align suppliers, development partners, and clinical and academic collaborators with the product plan. Support usability, clinical evaluation, regulatory planning, manufacturing readiness, and integration discussions.
* Write technical reports, including government sponsor reports, and give leadership and external stakeholders concise, candid updates on system performance, progress, decisions, risks, and resource needs.

Qualifications

* Five or more years in medical device development, including at least three years leading cross\-functional product development projects involving integrated hardware and software.
* Experience advancing at least one complex device through substantial design, system integration, verification, regulatory, or manufacturing\-transfer milestones.
* A technical degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on medical device development experience.
* Working knowledge of medical device design controls, ISO 13485, and verification and validation. Ability to translate these requirements into practical team deliverables.
* Strong technical judgment, clear writing, and the ability to drive decisions across disciplines without direct authority over every contributor.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced startup, adapting to shifting priorities and solving problems directly.

Especially relevant experience

* Surgical visualization, endoscopy, robotics, camera systems, or operating room capital equipment.
* Hands\-on systems engineering or quality work, especially requirements, interfaces, test planning, and design history documentation.
* Early\-stage companies, external development partners, clinical collaborators, or milestone\-based sponsored programs.

How to apply

Send your resume and a brief note about an integrated medical device program you led, the hardest technical or organizational risk you addressed, and the result to info@cisionvision.com.

**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  

  

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.  

  

Our capabilities include programs, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.  

We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**  

As a CBRE Project Management Consultant, you will be responsible for providing consulting services to an assigned market or client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives.


This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Manage all areas of project management for singular real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
* Work directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project. This includes the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates \& budget, work plan schedule \& milestones, quality control, and risk identification.

* Ensure project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely, and coordinated.
* Direct the project delivery team by providing guidance and direction to achieve goals.
* Create action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule. Track the progress of each project and report status and variances.
* Demonstrate ability to identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.
* Apply in\-depth knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish complex assignments and provide innovative solutions.
* Coach others and share in\-depth knowledge of own job discipline and broad knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.
* Impact a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities within own team and other related teams.
* Work within broad guidelines and policies.
* Explain difficult or sensitive information.
	+ - Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5\-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
		- Ability to exercise judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information.
		- Willingness to take a new perspective on existing solutions.
		- In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
		- Organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mindset.
		- Sophisticated math skills. Ability to calculate mildly complex figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and CCM designations preferred.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Intermediate math skills. Ability to calculate complicated figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations.

  

**Additional Information**  

The base salary range for this role is $125,000\-$140,000\. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

With a rich heritage spanning over 70 years, we have a proven track record of delivering outstanding results for our clients across various industries, including Infrastructure, Real Estate, Energy, and more. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
***Senior Project Manager*** Commercial Solar, Battery Storage \& Microgrids \| Sausalito, CA (Hybrid)

ABOUT THE COMPANY Our client is a well\-established independent energy consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience serving public agencies across California. Acting as a trusted owner's representative, the firm provides objective technical and project management expertise to help public\-sector clients plan, design, and deploy on\-site energy projects. These include solar, battery storage, EV charging, biogas generation, and in\-line hydro, and they reduce grid energy use and operating expenses.

The result for clients is energy infrastructure that lowers costs, strengthens resiliency through backup power, and advances sustainability goals. The firm is now rebuilding its internal systems to power its next chapter of growth. Its five\-year vision is to become a leaner, more tech\-forward, data\-driven organization and the go\-to energy consultant for public agencies in California.

LOCATION \& TRAVEL **Sausalito, CA. Hybrid schedule: in office Tuesday through Thursday, remote Monday and Friday.**  Travel for site walks and on\-site client meetings, typically one to two visits per month.

POSITION SUMMARY The Senior Project Manager will lead the deployment of commercial\-scale solar, battery storage, and microgrid projects for public\-sector clients throughout California. Serving as the owner's representative, you will guide projects from contract execution through commissioning and keep schedules, budgets, and technical requirements on track.

This role is built for a seasoned project leader who operates independently, thrives in complexity, solves problems proactively, and provides steady leadership to contractors, consultants, and public\-agency stakeholders. Hands\-on experience with the permitting processes and requirements of California electric utilities (PG\&E, SCE, SDG\&E, etc.), the State of California, counties, fire departments, and other AHJs is a must.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES **Lead microgrid projects: Manage advanced microgrid projects in California from contract signing through commissioning.**  Strengthen critical infrastructure: Support water and wastewater utilities in deploying resilient energy solutions that provide backup power and reduce electricity costs. **Work with experienced professionals: Collaborate with a small, highly experienced team with deep expertise in California's energy landscape.**  Make a meaningful impact: Deliver projects that directly support community resilience and long\-term sustainability.

QUALIFICATIONS **Demonstrated project management experience delivering commercial solar and battery storage projects in California.**  Engineering degree or equivalent technical experience. **Strong understanding of California utility rates, tariffs, permitting, and interconnection processes.**  Proven ability to lead contractors and guide public\-agency or institutional clients through complex projects. **Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.**  Self\-motivated, resourceful problem solver focused on communication and results.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE **Engineer holding a professional credential such as PMP, PE, or an equivalent project management or engineering certification.**  Background in project development, project management, or project engineering. **Track record managing commercial\-scale, behind\-the\-meter solar, battery storage, and/or microgrid projects (infrastructure and facilities) for California public agencies, utilities, municipalities, and special districts.**  Strong, clear communicator. **Customer\-centric with a genuine service mentality. Early in each engagement, the role focuses on advising and educating clients so they have the information to make the right decision for their needs. It then shifts to helping them build their projects.**

Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Sausalito, CA 94965

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in Circular Economy work streams, such as Trade\-in operations, Certified Pre\-Owned, or Refurbished sales businesses.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing complex, cross\-functional, or cross\-team projects with significant technical expertise.
* Experience in the consumer electronics hardware industry, particularly with product lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of the post\-sales value chain and experience designing new programs to drive growth in global markets (US, Japan, Europe).
* Proficiency in utilizing data analytics and financial modeling (Return on Investment/Net Present Value) to drive strategic investment decisions.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices \& Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices \& Services team is making people's lives better through technology.
  

  

Within Devices \& Services, this role is designed for a leader who grows in ambiguity and possesses a high degree of ownership over complex, large\-scale projects. You will bridge the gap between engineering, product management, and business units to ensure our post\-sales value chain is sustainable, profitable, and globally scalable. You will not only manage timelines and risks but also drive the strategic direction for circular economy initiatives, influencing how our hardware lives on through second and third life cycles.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Be part of strategic planning and execution of Residual Value (RV) and Certified Pre\-Owned (CPO) work streams, ensuring alignment with broader company objectives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional partners across product, supply chain, and engineering to solve complex operational bottlenecks and drive technical implementations.
* Own large\-scale project schedules from start to finish, identifying risks and communicating progress clearly to executive stakeholders across different time zones.
* Develop and standardize operational workflows for global CPO programs, focusing on key markets including the US, Japan, and Europe.
* Drive continuous process improvements in the post\-sales value chain, utilizing data analytics to uphold data integrity and uncover strategic insights.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management in an enterprise, cloud, or technology environment.
* Experience working with executive\-level clients or stakeholders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in process improvement or Lean Six Sigma.
* Experience in the business technology market as a program manager in SaaS, cloud computing, or emerging technologies.
* Experience with cross\-functional engineering, sales, and marketing teams in cloud computing or related fields.
* Experience managing expectations, needs, and priorities of executive internal stakeholders based on the overall goal and program success.
* Experience working effectively on a product, team, or process.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Program Manager for the AI \& Gemini App Marketing team, you will serve as a key operational engine connecting product and marketing strategy to seamless execution. Your core objective is to equip marketers with the tools, templates, and automated processes needed to move with speed, landing major launches and maintaining an ongoing drumbeat across Google’s top AI priorities.


This is a highly cross\-functional position where you will partner closely with Marketing leadership and connect dots across PR, product areas (such as Chrome and Android), and regional teams to bring our go\-to\-market strategy to life.


Things move quickly at Google. To deliver high\-impact results, you must rapidly absorb new context, build cross\-functional relationships across Marketing, Product, and Comms, and transform ambiguity into structured success. If you are ready to shape how Google launches AI to the world, this is the team for you.


Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems\-from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can\-changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $136000 \- $196000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own end\-to\-end program management across critical cross\-marketing initiatives, starting with early access/influencers, red teaming, and GTM enablement programs.
* Orchestrate multiple workstreams within a cross\-functional program, proactively identifying, tracking, and mitigating risks.
* Act as the vanguard for the team’s AI transformation, transitioning manual, fragmented templates, tools and processes into automated, real\-time ones.
* Act as a strategic bridge and escalation point across Product, Marketing, Legal, Comms, and regional teams to eliminate silos.

Associate Project Manager or Project Manager
============================================

* Location: Richmond, California
* Program: Clean Water
* Type: Full\-time
* Experience Level: Mid level
* Position Type: Permanent
* Salary: \[$92,750 \- $110,500]. See details below.
* Posting Date: September 28, 2026
* First review of applications: October 12, 2026
* Application closing date: October 26, 2026 or when 150 applications are received, whichever occurs first

Position Description
====================


SFEI’s Environmental Informatics \& Clean Water Programs are looking to add 1\-2 motivated Project Managers to help focus and facilitate the success of our technical teams as we tackle multi\-million dollar science and technology projects with regional and national impacts.


The position requires strong collaboration and task management skills. Work will include facilitating a diverse, intellectually stimulating, and impactful set of tasks, with local and national partners, budget management, contract management, project and financial reporting, and coordinating and organizing a diverse team of scientists.


A background or training in science or technology (e.g., bachelor's level) is needed to help track project tasks, strategize during budgeting and timeline development, and draft contract scopes. The ideal candidate possesses strong communication and organizational skills, proactive planning skills, ability to multitask, ability to track and see tasks through to completion, and ability to communicate with different staff and partners/funders on progress and potential issues.


This is a great opportunity for someone who has strong skills to join a larger project management team to help diverse and innovative technical teams accomplish project goals aimed toward making positive environmental change.

* Primary position responsibilities will include:
* Support the development and management of budgets, work plans, and progress reports with the goal of delivering projects on time and on budget
* Coordinate and attend internal team meetings to track project tasks, deadlines, and deliverables
* In coordination with contract staff, develop contracts with external partners and laboratories
* Organize project documentation in shared systems and maintain consistent PM workflows.
* Utilize our primary accounting and labor planning software (Deltek), including developing queries, developing and tracking budgets, and updating labor resource planning to provide information to manage and organize projects
* Use project management tools, including Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to analyze and summarize budgets, deliverables, and other project items (e.g., pivot tables and graphics)
* Manage a portfolio of projects, simultaneously, and organize project documentation in shared systems to maintain consistent workflows
* Help coordinate review cycles for reports, memos, figures, presentations, and other deliverables.
* Flag delays, unclear ownership, resource constraints, or emerging project risks
* Support technical leads on proposal and project logistics, administrative requirements, formatting, review cycles, and possibly content development
* Assist with project start\-up and wrap\-up, and scheduling meetings at important junctions to keep the team on track

We seek highly organized and technically\-strong candidates with expertise in project management.Required Experience
-------------------

* Minimum requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Ecology, Technology, or other relevant field plus at least 4 years of project management experience or Master’s degree plus at least 2 years of project management experience.

Required Skills
---------------

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to manage and prioritize a variety of detail\-oriented tasks successfully
* Must be a self\-starter and able to proactively anticipate next steps
* Strong organizational skills
* Must possess strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Suite Applications, especially Excel and/or Google Sheets
* Ability to work independently with moderate supervision and in a team environment

Preferred Skills
----------------

* Interest in working in a mission\-driven environmental science non\-profit
* Interest in advancement along a Project Management path (this is not a science position though some science or technology background is required)
* Experience managing state and federal grants (e.g. EPA, NOAA)

Salary \& Benefits highlights
=============================

* This will be an Associate Project Manager or Project Manager position (depending on degree/experience). The anticipated salary range is $92,750 \- $110,500 for this position (Bay Area salary ranges are listed; note that salary ranges for other locations are 10\-15% lower depending on location and are based on locational salary data). **DEPARTMENT: Community Wellness Department (CWD)**  

**REPORTS TO: Senior Program Manager**  

**LOCATION: Native American Health Center, Inc. (NAHC)**  

**WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE**  

**STATUS: Non\-Union, Exempt**

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Community Wellness Department’s program goals include maximizing the quality of the member experience and clinical outcomes. This is achieved through an integrated, team\-oriented, strengths\-based holistic healthcare approach. CWD incorporates prevention, community\-engagement and cultural\-competence, and integration of behavioral health treatment with a particular focus on the local urban Native American community. **The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------


As a Manager, Digital Transformation \- Quality Management, you will help transform Lam’s global Quality processes and digital capabilities. You will serve as a Business Subject Matter Expert, partnering with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, IT, and implementation teams to design and deploy integrated Quality Management System solutions.You will translate business needs into clear requirements, guide process and solution design, and drive business ownership of testing, training, deployment, and post\-go\-live stabilization. **What you’ll do**
------------------

* Serve as the Business Subject Matter Expert for assigned Quality Management processes.
* Evaluate current\-state processes and define standardized, scalable, and compliant future\-state workflows.
* Gather, document, prioritize, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Translate Quality business needs into clear requirements for implementation and technology teams.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements, process designs, test scenarios, and delivered solutions.
  

  

**Solution Design and Governance**


* Participate in process design, solution design, and fit\-to\-standard workshops.

* Represent Quality in governance forums and support timely, well\-informed business decisions.
* Ensure solutions align with Lam’s Quality Management System requirements and Digital Transformation principles.

* Own or coordinate business testing for assigned Quality processes and capabilities.
* Review and approve test scenarios, scripts, acceptance criteria, and results.
* Coordinate or execute Functional Testing, System Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing.
* Lead business defect identification, prioritization, retesting, and closure.
* Support data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, mock conversions, and cutover readiness.
* Confirm that Quality processes, solutions, and business data are ready for deployment.
**What you'll do (continued)**
------------------------------


**Change Management, Training, and Deployment**


* Serve as a Change Champion for new Quality processes and digital capabilities.
* Support change\-impact assessments, stakeholder communications, and business\-readiness activities.
* Review training materials, procedures, work instructions, and job aids for functional accuracy.
* Deliver or support role\-based training, demonstrations, and knowledge\-transfer sessions.
* Participate in deployment\-readiness reviews, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare activities.
* Resolve business\-process issues and support users during post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Support the transition from project delivery to ongoing operational support.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**


* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, IT, and other Digital Transformation workstreams.
* Ensure that Quality processes and data are effectively integrated across relevant enterprise processes and systems.
* Gather end\-user feedback and identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, and improve the user experience.
* Support future releases, process improvements, and QMS enhancements.
* Measure user adoption, process performance, data quality, and business outcomes.
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process.
* Run change management for projects and programs and support proper project closure.

-------------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Information Technology, Business, Operations Management, or a related field with a minimum of 12 years of related experience; or 8 years of related experience with a Master’s degree; or 5 years of related experience with a PhD; or equivalent experience.
* Six or more years of experience in Quality Management, including hands\-on experience with enterprise Quality Management Systems.
* Experience supporting the implementation, enhancement, or deployment of a digital QMS solution.
* Demonstrated knowledge of end\-to\-end Quality processes, such as Non\-Conformance, Corrective and Preventive Action, Supplier Quality, Part Qualification, Design Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Audit,
* Compliance, Document Management, or Training Management.
* Experience defining and validating business requirements and participating in Quality process and solution\-design workshops.
* Experience with business testing, including Functional Testing, System Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing.
* Working knowledge of Quality Management System principles, closed\-loop Quality processes, data integrity, and business controls.
* Experience supporting organizational change, end\-user training, deployment, or post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate with and influence cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic transformation environment.

jobs.description:
**Substitute Program Leader**  

**Status: Part\-Time** **Pay Rate: $24\.00/hour**  

**Substitute Program** **Leaders** may work at different sites throughout the region and receive their assignments based on their availability. Substitute Program Leaders work directly with a group of students (ratio is contingent upon CDC guidelines), acting as a positive adult role model, coach, and mentor. Substitute Program Leaders must have a genuine interest in the growth, development, and provision of a safe and nurturing environment for the students they teach. Substitute Program Leader’s ability to establish authority through leadership, communication, and most importantly patience, will be required in giving our students the stability and nurturing atmosphere they need to succeed. Ensuring that Think Together students reach their potential takes a tremendous amount of hard work, flexibility, and commitment. **Responsibilities:*** Provide homework assistance, academic enrichment and physical activity, using curriculum and materials provided by the program.
* Create an engaging environment that fosters a sense of belonging that kids want to be in.
* Support students in making positive behavior choices and take disciplinary measures when appropriate.
* Engage children and youth by following, implementing, and assisting in creating lesson plans.
* Ensure student safety by assisting in set up, break down, and ongoing maintenance in an effort to keep the school or community site clean and orderly.
* Promote positive interactions between volunteers and students in accordance with child safety guidelines.
* Maintain student safety by taking roll and reviewing sign\-in/ sign\-outs for students and volunteers.
* Identify student needs and communicate to Site Coordinator, teachers, school administration, parents, and volunteers as appropriate.
* Commit to a full\-year program, demonstrated by arriving on\-time, every day and completing time cards appropriately.
* Participate in staff development activities.

**Requirements:*** Experience working with young children and the ability to inspire and motivate.
* Proof of graduation from High School or G.E.D. Required;
* Additionally / 48 college semester or 60 college quarter units required / and/or by passing an Instructional Aide Test (in some districts)
* Ability to speak and write standard English appropriate in a public school setting.
* Must be available at least 3 days a week (Monday\-Friday)
* Program start and end times are roughly between 1:00 PM\- 6:00 PM. Times may vary due to minimum day schedules at school sites.

**Background Checks/Testing:*** Must pass Live Scan (criminal background check via fingerprinting)
* Provide a clear TB test
* Pass Advanced Math and English skills (K – 8\) testing

Description:

Under the direct supervision of the Supervisor, Family Support Services (FSS) Program, the **Early Childhood Quality Assurance Coordinator,** provides programmatic, operational, and quality support to the FSS team to ensure compliance with program standards, quality assurance practices, and effective service delivery. This position serves as a key support resource to Case Managers by assisting with workflow coordination, chart oversight, data quality monitoring, compliance activities, and administrative functions that strengthen program operations and client services.


The Quality Assurance Coordinator plays an essential role in maintaining documentation accuracy, supporting staff onboarding and training, promoting best practices in case management and early childhood services, and assisting leadership with daily program operations, reporting, and quality improvement initiatives. This position maintains a reduced caseload of approximately five (5\) families while balancing operational and quality assurance responsibilities. Direct service responsibilities are secondary to operational and quality assurance functions and may be adjusted based on program needs.


This position does not provide direct supervision of staff but serves as a functional lead and quality support resource for the Family Support Services team. This position is ideal for a detail\-oriented and collaborative professional who is passionate about improving service quality, supporting staff success, and strengthening outcomes for children and families.

**Schedule:** This is a full\-time position, working 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday hours.

* Collaborate with internal departments and community partners to support coordinated service delivery, operational effectiveness, and compliance efforts.
* Monitor and report office safety concerns, compliance issues, and adherence to TVHC safety guidelines to the Program Manager.
