jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**


Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

 **About the role**


Crowe’s Metals \& Materials Consulting practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Consultant** to help shape the future of our D365 practice. This role offers the opportunity to lead solution architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and work directly with finance and operations leaders across manufacturing and distribution organizations.

  

If you want meaningful impact, autonomy, and a clear path to practice leadership, this is a strategic career opportunity—not just another consulting role.

 **What You Will Lead and Influence**

* Architect and lead end\-to\-end D365 Finance solutions that deliver measurable outcomes for mid\-market and enterprise clients.
* Advise senior stakeholders, including CFOs and Operations leaders, to define requirements and design transformation roadmaps.
* Set solution direction and guide delivery teams to ensure projects meet scope, quality, and client expectations.
* Lead functional design, feature optimization, data integrity, and user experience improvements to maximize platform value.
* Participate in quality reviews and steer project teams through design, prototyping, and deployment phases.
* Contribute to Crowe’s methodologies, accelerators, and best practices; mentor team members; and support the growth of our D365 offering.
* Engage in team\-building and internal initiatives, leveraging non\-client time for personal development and practice enhancement.

 **What Makes Crowe a Strong Career Move**

* **High\-impact role** with direct influence on solution strategy and client outcomes.
* **Rapidly growing D365 Finance practice** backed by a nationally recognized consulting brand.
* **Clear advancement path** into Solution Architect, Industry Lead, or Practice Leadership roles.
* **Strong investment in your development** (certification support, training, conferences, thought leadership opportunities).
* **Collaborative culture** that values quality, innovation, and balanced workloads.
* **Flexible work environment** with predictable, project\-based travel (25%–50%).

 **Experience That Makes You Successful (Must\-Have)**

* Bachelors degree required.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on D365 Finance implementation leadership or equivalent ERP delivery experience.
* Proven track record delivering complex, full\-lifecycle D365 Finance projects.
* Strong functional expertise across core finance and operational modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash/Bank, Reporting, etc.).
* Ability to lead solution architecture, translate requirements into actionable designs, and guide teams through execution.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, produce high\-quality work products, and lead engagements with minimal oversight.

 **Preferred**

* Experience in Manufacturing or Distribution environments; Metals industry exposure highly valued.
* Strong functional expertise across operational modules (Procurement, Inventory, etc.).
* Experience with complementary ISV solutions within the D365 ecosystem.
* D365 certifications in Finance or related modules; CPA, CMA, or CFA a plus.
* Prior consulting experience within a professional services environment.

 **Why You’ll Thrive Here**

* Opportunity to shape the direction of the D365 practice.
* Access to diverse and challenging client environments.
* Supportive leadership that values initiative and thought leadership.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

 *We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening!*

 *\#LI\-Hybrid*

Kentro is hiring a **Business Analyst III** to support the **Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Accelerated Transformation of Legacy Applications and Systems (ATLAS)** program. The ideal candidate will have experience analyzing business, mission, technology, and operational requirements and translating them into actionable recommendations that support portfolio modernization and optimization. The Business Analyst will also collaborate with the Chief Architect and a multi\-disciplined team to use the results of this analysis to validate portfolio inventory, establish traceable decision criteria, develop portfolio metrics, and support dashboards, governance artifacts, and executive decision support. **Location:** Remote \- This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours. **Compensation Range:** The pay range for this position is $99,000\-118,000 annually. Responsibilities:
* Support FAA portfolio rationalization efforts, including discovery, inventory, categorization, and analysis of applications, systems, services, and supporting technologies.
* Gather and analyze business, mission, operational, technical, security, and compliance requirements from stakeholders and system owners; document source, ownership, confidence, assumptions, and unresolved gaps for material requirements.
* Develop and maintain traceable portfolio inventories, capability maps, application profiles, dependency maps, and other analytical artifacts with source provenance and decision linkage.
* Identify and validate opportunities for consolidation, integration, modernization, migration, replacement, or retirement.
* Analyze relationships and dependencies between business capabilities, applications, infrastructure, data, and enterprise services.
* Develop business cases and decision\-support materials that quantify mission impact, cost, risk, dependencies, and expected modernization outcomes.
* Translate stakeholder needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, process models, and acceptance criteria where appropriate.
* Support development of current\-state and future\-state architectures in collaboration with enterprise and solution architects.
* Analyze business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, standardization, and service delivery.
* Establish governed metrics and dashboards to track portfolio health, rationalization progress, investment decisions, and modernization outcomes using reconciled source data, documented definitions, and repeatable calculation logic.
* Prepare executive\-level briefings, presentations, reports, and recommendations for FAA and program leadership.
* Support ongoing governance processes and maintain traceability from business and mission objectives through requirements, capabilities, system disposition decisions, and acceptance criteria.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5\-7 years of experience with IT portfolio management, application rationalization, enterprise architecture, or technology modernization.
* Strong requirements analysis, process modeling, data analysis, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to interrogate and reconcile structured datasets using SQL or equivalent analysis tools.
* Experience working across business and technical organizations.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into clear business and executive\-level recommendations.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Proficiency in the use of AI tools for analysis


**Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience with FAA, federal IT, or other federal governance processes is highly desirable.
* Experience as a Business Analyst supporting complex government, aviation, transportation, or enterprise IT environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and tools is desirable.

**Clearance Requirement:*** US Citizen
* Existing FAA suitability determination or transferable federal background investigation strongly preferred

As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Program Manager to lead cross\-team, multi\-vendor coordination that keeps the VA's patient\-generated health data (PGHD) ecosystem running reliably, supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Connected Care. This role oversees delivery across the VA's PGHD applications, Validic's aggregation platform, and emerging integrations such as Google Health, spanning technical alignment, stakeholder management, cross\-team orchestration, and data\-quality oversight. The Program Manager enables national\-scale delivery of device\-derived health data to VA clinicians and Veterans, aligning program goals, stakeholder needs, and technical execution to mission\-critical outcomes. Strong candidates bring program management and Agile delivery experience, plus the ability to navigate complex enterprise healthcare systems.  

This is a fully remote (United States) position and may require up to 10% travel for quarterly reviews.
Responsibilities:

The Program Manager coordinates delivery across multiple products, vendors, and teams in a matrixed environment, supervising staff who may or may not be supporting the work this position functionally oversees. This role aligns efforts across engineering, integration partners, and system owners; manages schedules and status reporting; resolves issues to meet productivity, quality, and client\-satisfaction goals; and monitors progress across the portfolio, stepping in to solve problems with team members and stakeholders. Generally reports to a Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Lead.* Supervise staff in a matrixed environment, including performance oversight, coaching, hiring, and professional development, recognizing that direct reports may or may not support the work this position functionally oversees
* Lead cross\-functional coordination between VA teams, Validic, and third\-party device vendors, aligning priorities, managing issue remediation, and communicating progress across CGM (Abbott, Dexcom), nutrition and sleep data pathways, and new device integrations
* Drive the Google Health API transition across the VA's PGHD applications and pipelines, managing discrepancy tracking, SQA testing follow\-ups, OAuth/CASA approval workflows, and vendor inquiry resolution to keep step, energy\-burned, resting heart rate, and sleep metrics accurate as legacy device APIs sunset
* Coordinate investigation and resolution of data\-quality issues across multiple sources (for example, duplicate CGM records, dropped components in sequential updates, conflicting event ID updates, and observation\-volume drops following SDK changes), synthesizing findings for pipeline teams and Validic engineering
* Facilitate vendor partnerships and support negotiations for new integrations, driving expansion efforts such as new CGM and activity\-data pathways and the API and org\-settings updates they require
* Manage pre\-read and action\-item workflows to ensure productive, well\-prepared coordination sessions, producing pre\-read materials, organizing agendas, and maintaining cross\-team action logs across CGM, device mapping, pipeline fixes, and API transitions
* Oversee alignment across PGHD applications, mobile and web teams, and downstream pipelines, ensuring synchronized release planning, remediation of SQA\-identified issues, correct application of device\-definition rules, and consistent handling of edge cases
* Manage integrated program plans, including risk and status reporting
* Resolve cross\-team blockers and escalate risks to leadership as needed
* Provide oversight of sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives across teams, ensuring they are carried out effectively and meet delivery goals
* Serve as a central liaison across VA digital health programs, collaborating with PGHD governance groups, clinical SMEs, OIT, pipeline engineering, and product teams to maintain unified progress toward national PGHD goals
* Manage vendor and integration partner deliverables, ensuring quality standards are met
* Advise clients on strategic and technical solution options


Qualifications:
**Required Skills and experience**

* Bachelors degree with 12\+ years experience (or commensurate experience)
* Experience supporting federal programs or within the VA/OCC environment
* Familiarity with health data integration platforms such as Validic, or with CGM/remote patient monitoring data (for example, Abbott, Dexcom)
* Experience with health data API transitions or integrations such as Google Health or similar device APIs
* Experience with native mobile (iOS and Android) and web product delivery
* Background working with patient\-generated health data (PGHD) or clinical data sources
* Knowledge of compliance standards, OAuth/CASA workflows, or healthcare\-related systems
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks, APIs, cloud platforms, or DevSecOps
* Experience with backlog tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Experience working with distributed, remote teams

**Clearance required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.


Posted Salary Range: USD $150,000\.00 \- USD $160,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Tax Account Manager
jobs.description:
OneSource Virtual (OSV) has worked exclusively with Workday customers since 2008 to deliver compliant, in\-tenant technology and expert services to automate the administrative, transactional tasks of payroll, taxes, earned wage access, accounts payable, and benefits. With over 1,500 customers, 92% retention, and $225\+ billion in treasury movement annually, OSV helps organizations maximize their Workday investment and operate it with confidence. Payroll, benefits, and finance solutions — all in one place.

**Summary**


The Tax Account Manager is responsible for customer engagement in regard to the Tax operation and services, allowing customer teams and Tax Operations to focus on service delivery commitments. They will have an understanding of the OSV tax business and the customers’ tax business in order to optimize the delivery of the tax services. They will take a strategic and proactive approach with customer plans, and closely interact with the Payroll and Garnishment customer contacts to deliver a holistic operational view. They will be empowered and have the authority to drive health plans and escalations across the customer and tax operations teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Enhance and maintain customer relationships via regular engagement, leading customer analytic review, ROI attainment and roadmap planning.
* Serve as an operations customer advocate and liaison throughout the OSV organization as needed for customer changes (bank, company, ADM).
* Form relationships with the SDM, CSM and Account Executive teams in building an understanding of customer requirements and business drivers.
* Serve as the tax primary point of contact for customer resources and ensure effective communication and hand offs occur within service delivery support teams.
* In coordination with payroll and garnishments, prepare recurring operations reports for customers and narrate strategic value/ROI of OSV services in addition to basic service delivery metrics, KPIs, and SLAs. Solicit customer feedback and obtain strategic vs tactical objectives.
* Communicate change to services, technology platforms, and products to assigned customers.
* Partner with Customer Teams, Product, and R\&D to bring forth people, process and technology enhancement ideas and assist with associated deployment.
* Support customer renewal and reference programs.
* Responsible for managing customer tax account escalations and resolving complex customer problems
* Acts as the tax account subject matter expert for assigned customers and Demonstrate knowledge of OSV services and processes to advise customers on tax best practices
* Perform ongoing gap analyses and identifies solutions to ensure OSV delivers quality services
* Proactively lead roadmap planning to ensure year\-end and quarter\-end processing is managed effectively

**Competencies**

* Analytical and Problem Solving skills
* Exhibiting professionalism and diplomacy
* Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
* Excellent project management, documentation and communication skills
* Must be customer service oriented
* Extensive experience in managing Customer relationships with confidence and presence to deal with customers and executives (both internal and customer facing)
* Highly analytical in problem solving with the ability to partner across OSV to achieve customer satisfaction via innovation, customer centric process and consistent service delivery quality
* A high level of oral and written communication skills in order to communicate effectively with leadership, colleagues and other stakeholders
* Ability to use Workday and OSV Service knowledge to provide best practice recommendations to customers.
* To maintain a sound knowledge and understanding of current methodologies, technologies, services and tools.

**Qualifications**

**Education/Certification** **Requirement**


Bachelor's degree

**Required**

* 4\+ years of experience in Maintenance and/or Managed Services as well as customer relationship management role
* Functional knowledge of human resources outsourcing with emphasis on tax
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)

**Preferred**

* Experience with internal OSV BPaaS processes and procedures
* Extensive Workday exposure in services bureau or customer
* Functional knowledge of human resources outsourcing with emphasis on payroll and garnishments
* Prior HR services portfolio management, Customer Engagement
* Management, or Account Executive role in HR Services Industry, preferred


\#LI\-REMOTE


You are encouraged to learn and share ideas when you join the OneSource Virtual team. We reward innovative thinking, fresh perspectives, creative collaboration, and hard work. As an organization experiencing routine strategic growth, we are always on the lookout for intelligent, talented, and forward\-thinking professionals to join our team. OSV employees enjoy a values\-based culture, upward mobility, and professional development with opportunities of all kinds.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Bilingual Operations Manager – Commercial Cleaning Company

We are a growing commercial cleaning company based in Los Angeles looking for a dependable, highly organized **Bilingual Operations Manager** to take ownership of our day\-to\-day operations.

This is a **long\-term, fixed monthly position** for someone who wants to become an important part of the business. We are not looking for someone juggling many freelance clients or looking for a short\-term project.

What You'll Be Responsible For

You will help make sure the business runs smoothly each day, including:

* Communicating with clients by email, phone, and text
* Scheduling cleaning jobs and coordinating cleaner teams
* Handling schedule changes, call\-outs, and operational issues
* Following up with leads and prospective clients
* Managing calendars and keeping schedules accurate
* Preparing and tracking invoices
* Tracking client payments and following up when necessary
* Coordinating with cleaners and subcontractors through WhatsApp
* Making sure important client and team requests are followed through to completion
* Requesting reviews and following up with clients after service
* Identifying problems early and helping make sure they are resolved

Who We're Looking For

The right person is someone who **takes ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks**.

You should be:

* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Dependable and consistent
* Proactive and comfortable taking initiative
* Good at following through until something is fully handled
* Comfortable making decisions and solving day\-to\-day problems
* Able to manage multiple conversations and priorities without losing track of details
* Comfortable working independently without constant supervision

You must be **fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken**, and comfortable handling professional phone calls, texts, and messages in both languages.

Availability

The workload is flexible when operations are quiet. However, commercial cleaning often takes place outside normal business hours, so you should generally have your phone available and be able to respond when an important scheduling or operational issue comes up.

This does **not** mean constantly working. It means being dependable when something time\-sensitive needs attention.

Compensation

**$2,000 USD per month, fixed monthly rate.**

This is intended to be a long\-term role. As the company grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility and increase compensation.

We are looking for someone who wants to learn the business, become trusted with its day\-to\-day operations, and grow with us over time.

Pay: $1,800\.00 \- $2,400\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Remote Client Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Client Operations Supervisor
  
  

**Summary of Position:**  

Under the direction of the Director of Client Operations and the general instruction of the Facility Contact at various facilities, the Client Operations Supervisor is responsible for the efficient operation of assigned accounts. In addition, the Client Operations Supervisor will also assist in training, staffing, and providing coverage at various sites.
  
  

**Duties \& Responsibilities:**  

* Answers day\-to\-day questions posed by clients and Release of Information Specialists (ROIS).
* Responsible for meeting facility revenue goals on a consistent basis.
* Identifies and recommends opportunities to increase productivity.
* Complies with all release of information related functions, as stipulated by service agreement.
* Prepares weekly dashboard and month\-end Operational performance reports Monitors productivity and quality to ensure high customer service satisfaction.
* Assists the Director of Client Operations in the training and evaluation of ROIS staff, both onsite and remote.
* Assists in selecting, interviewing, hiring and terminating of employees.
* Participates in counseling sessions of site personnel and makes disciplinary or termination recommendations, when necessary.
* Manages scheduling of onsite staff to include time off requests and payroll approval
* Assists remote supervisors with the coordination of work.
* Distributes workflow to site personnel.
* Maintains confidentiality by keeping all information seen and heard in the facility secure.
* Provides input into the review and revision of site procedure.
* Performs quality reviews and site evaluations as required by clients.
* Reviews release of information requests for validity according to applicable state or federal statutes; returns inappropriate authorizations and requests to the requester.
* Looks up medical record numbers, fills out guides and pulls medical records, when appropriate.
* Reviews the requests to determine which encounters are being requested.
* Scans and/or captures electronically, the medical record and chooses the appropriate information to be duplicated.
* Captures the appropriate pages for the requested records, when appropriate.
* Re\-assembles the charts (if paper) for re\-filing.
* Logs information that is being sent to the requester either manually or using company software in accordance with the facility procedure.
* Documents the release of information in the patient medical record or other means determined by the facility.
* Calculates billing and prepares invoices, as needed.
* Certifies medical records copies, when appropriate.
* Attends all mandatory meetings and/or training sessions.
* Ensures supplies are available at designated facility.
* Submits company\-related travel expense reports and original receipts to manager in a timely fashion.
* Complies with and provides guidance on Company Policies, as identified in the Company Handbook.
* Performs other appropriate duties, as assigned, to meet the needs of the department and the company.


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* A High School Diploma or GED is required, some college preferred.
* RHIT Certification, preferred.
* A valid driver’s license and a history of safe driving.
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients, staff members and management.
* Experience with medical records or healthcare, beneficial.
* Knowledge of HIPAA privacy information standards, required.
* Medical terminology coursework, preferred
* RHIT certification or the ability to take and pass an ROI Certification course with a score of 85% or higher, within 90 days is required.
* Ability to travel.

**Overview**

Women's Connection, a national nonprofit for women over 50, is looking for a hands\-on operations and systems manager to keep our organization running smoothly.

Reporting to a member of our Board of Directors, you will enjoy a broad range of responsibilities, working with volunteers across the country. This is a fun and rewarding job for someone who is comfortable with technology, thrives in a highly collaborative environment, and likes to lead projects that are important to an organization's future wellbeing.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary administrator of the organization's website.
* Build and run reports using the website's report writer and other tools.
* Plan and lead strategic projects that involve women throughout the country.
* Implement systems changes, overseeing data cleanup, migration, testing, rollout and user training.
* Manage shared drives, groups and permissions in Google Workspace.
* Administer Zoom accounts and support meeting hosts for national events.
* Coordinate the annual budgeting cycle.
* Maintain the organization’s compliance calendar and ensure that filings are completed on time.
* Develop and document operational procedures so that essential organizational knowledge is easily transferred.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and strengthen administrative processes.
* Manage the organization’s relationship with Club Express and other technology providers.

**Qualifications**

jobs.description:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical\-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value\-based\-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality\-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50\+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48\-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi\-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short\-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution\-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost\-per\-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under\-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well\-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross\-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

**Adoption.** Shipping is half the job. You own whether features are actually used: rollout plans, in\-product guidance, enablement materials and documentation, adoption targets per release, and follow\-up on the ones that miss. A feature sitting at 11% adoption is an open problem, not a completed ticket.

**Practices.** Help raise how the whole product function works — brief and spec templates, definition of ready and done, the decision log, the metrics review. We're building the PM layer close to from scratch, and you'll leave real fingerprints on it.

What we're looking for

**Required**

* 3–5 years as a product manager, **including healthcare product experience** — clinical workflow, care management, population health, digital health, RCM, or an equivalent regulated clinical domain
* Hands\-on experience owning **integrations with third\-party systems** — EHRs, clearinghouses, device or telephony vendors, data partners — and a clear point of view on what makes an integration feel seamless to the user and observable to the team running it
* A track record of shipping: features that reached production and changed a number you can name
* Experience with workflow\-heavy products used by demanding daily users under time pressure
* Strong discovery instincts — you go to where the work happens rather than relying on tickets and secondhand requests
* Fluency with metrics. You can define them, instrument them, question them, and resist the pretty ones that don't drive decisions
* Excellent written communication. We run on written briefs, specs, and decisions across several time zones
* Comfort owning a release process: coordinating QA, managing scope under deadline, and being accountable when it slips
* Enough technical depth to hold a real design discussion with engineers — you don't need to code, but you do need to understand what you're asking for
* Authorized to work in the US

**A strong plus**

* Working knowledge of quality measures and gap closure (HEDIS or similar) — specs, eligibility, evidence, measurement per

jobs.description:
**Energy Project Solutions (EPS)** is an energy consulting firm that helps partners deliver efficient, high\-value projects through localized expertise and real\-world insight. With more than 500 years of collective experience, our team leads complex energy developments from inception through construction, bringing deep knowledge across engineering, real estate, business development, and finance while leveraging strong relationships with developers, owners, financial institutions, and property owners nationwide.


This is an opportunity to sit at the center of complex energy and infrastructure projects and help turn strategy into execution. As a **Project Manager** within our **Procurement Services** group, you'll play a key role in sourcing, logistics, quality, and material coordination, working cross\-functionally to ensure the right materials, vendors, and processes are in place to support successful project delivery. If you enjoy ownership, problem\-solving, and building structure in fast\-moving environments, this role offers meaningful impact from day one.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Execute and support sourcing activities including RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, and commercial coordination.

* Manage vendor relationships, monitor performance, and support contract administration and issue resolution.
* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and trade compliance activities to ensure timely and compliant material delivery.
* Support quality surveillance and inspection activities, including documentation, reporting, and non\-conformance tracking.

**Who You Are**

**Department:** Professional Services


**Salary:** $125,000\-$175,000


**FLSA Status:** Exempt


**Positions Supervised:** TBD


**Location:** Remote

### **About the Role**


The Project Manager will own Consortium's Project Management Office (PMO) and is responsible for the standards, processes, and governance that guide every professional services engagement, in addition to coordinating and monitoring the execution of multiple concurrent, client\-facing projects from initiation through closeout.

  



This role partners with service leaders, project teams, clients, Finance \& Accounting, Contracting, and other stakeholders to drive projects forward and ensure they are delivered against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual commitments. The Project Manager provides ongoing visibility into project performance — including milestones, resource requirements, budget performance, risks, issues, and forecasted outcomes — and serves as the primary owner of consistency and accountability across engagements.

  



As the organization continues to mature its PMO, this role owns the continuous adoption and improvement of standardized processes and governance practices, ensuring they are defined, maintained, and followed consistently across all projects and delivery teams.

  



### **Essential Responsibilities**


* Own and maintain the Project Governance Framework — the standards, templates, methodology, and delivery requirements that govern project and services quality and consistency across the organization.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies, tracking progress toward each milestone.
* Build standardized kickoff decks and lead both internal kickoff reviews and customer\-facing kickoff calls.
* Coordinate with internal delivery teams on resourcing decisions and serve as the primary point of contact for customers on project status, timelines, and reporting; actively monitor project schedule, budget, milestones, and deliverables to ensure timely, uninterrupted completion of projects.
* Run status meetings with follow\-up notes, maintaining a consistent reporting cadence with both customers and internal leadership.
* Enforce time\-entry compliance across assigned consultants, and track budget hours and dollars against actual utilization, flagging variances early.
* Document all scope, schedule, or budget changes as formal change orders before associated work begins.
* Identify and escalate delivery, scope, or budget risks per the Project Governance Framework's escalation path, driving resolution to all project\-related risks and issues.
* Partner with Finance/Accounting on invoicing and forecasting inputs.
* Manage project closeout — gathering deliverables, closing tasks, storing documentation, and verifying invoicing.
* Support after\-action/lessons\-learned reviews for projects as required.
* Own the continual improvement of PMO processes and the project delivery experience, driving adoption across all delivery teams in partnership with leadership.
* Other duties as necessary to ensure profitability and/or as directed by management.

### **Desired Skills \& Experience**


* Experience building, running, or maturing a PMO — including defining standards, templates, and governance frameworks and driving adoption across teams outside direct reporting lines.
* Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, resource allocation, risks, issues, and forecasting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Experience with CRM and professional services automation (PSA) platforms.
* Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts, milestone\-based billing, and working alongside Finance/Accounting teams.
* Comfortable engaging stakeholders at all levels, internally and with clients.
* Outstanding time management and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable running both internal and customer\-facing meetings.
* Detail\-oriented, with a track record of enforcing process discipline across project teams.
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast\-paced consulting or professional services environment.

### **Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of project management experience, ideally within a cybersecurity consulting or professional services organization.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification strongly preferred.

### **Success Metrics**


* Budget variance — planned vs. actual hours and dollars.
* On\-time delivery against the committed schedule.
* Utilization of assigned consultants against planned hours.
* Forecast accuracy — quarterly Rev/Rec forecast vs. actual.
* Timely and accurate project reporting.
* Client and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Adoption of, and compliance with, PMO processes and governance across all delivery teams.
* Progress against the PMO maturity roadmap defined in the Project Governance Framework.

### **Additional Info**


Consortium Networks is dedicated to supporting our employees through comprehensive benefits, including full coverage for medical, dental, and vision care, a generous paid time off policy, and a positive, growth\-oriented work environment.

  



**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. You are a collaborative, analytical senior environmental planning professional with extensive experience applying the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) to complex federal actions. jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. With team members around the world, and a rich legacy spanning more than 50 years, Versar delivers solutions across a broad array of planning, analysis, risk management, operations and maintenance services, and information technology applications for environmental management and remediation projects, mission critical facilities and infrastructure, and in support of readiness and contingency operations.

**Who You Are:**


Versar Global Solutions is seeking a full\-time Project Coordinator who will possess knowledge and experience helping project managers build and manage scopes of work required in the performance of a United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Recurring Maintenance and Minor Repair (RMMR) task order. Duties include developing technical scopes of work; processing project packages in required timelines; invoicing work; coordinating among clients, contractors, site personnel and project team; developing, updating and maintaining project schedules; participating in project team meetings.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Develop technical scopes of work for repair and modification Service Orders for Department of Defense (DoD) Fuel facilities as part of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Recurring Maintenance and Minor Repair (RMMR) program. * Attend project update meetings, ensuring accurate lists and statuses for each service order assigned.

* Four years of project management, project coordination, or related experience in a technical field.

* Ability to use/understand basic accounting principles, as it pertains to invoicing and revenue.
* Proven ability to communicate, both written and verbally, for internal and external clients.
* Able to react to dynamic situations and retain effectiveness.

**Physical Demands:**


This position requires the individual to use the computer working at a desk in either an office or cubicle; must be able to talk and hear, reach with hands and arms, lift 25 pounds, sit, stand, and walk, must have close and color vision, use depth and peripheral vision, be able to adjust focus.

**About Sanguine Biosciences, Inc.**


Sanguine Biosciences is accelerating personalized medicine research by empowering patients with their healthcare data and making it as easy as possible for them to participate in the medical research process. We partner with patients and pharmaceutical companies to accelerate precision medicine R\&D by securely and efficiently collecting and providing patient samples and relevant health data. We are helping thousands of researchers at 20 of the top 40 global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies increase the speed and quality at which they are conducting their research. It is an exciting time; our biotech company is growing quickly and needs the best team members to join us.

 **About the Role:**


The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. This role is accountable for oversight and effectiveness of change control, Computer System Validation (CSV), including validation of GxP\-relevant software, AI\-assisted/low\-code/no\-code tools, and native\-built applications, risk management, supplier/vendor quality, deviation/complaint handling, CAPA, internal auditing, and training. The QA Manager partners cross\-functionally to drive a culture of quality, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**


 The Quality Assurance Manager provides day\-to\-day leadership for key Quality Management System (QMS) processes and the Quality team, ensuring continued suitability, compliance, and scalability of the QMS as the business grows. This role is accountable for oversight and effectiveness of change control, Computer System Validation (CSV), including validation of GxP\-relevant software, AI\-assisted/low\-code/no\-code tools, and native\-built applications, risk management, supplier/vendor quality, deviation/complaint handling, CAPA, internal auditing, and training. The QA Manager partners cross\-functionally to drive a culture of quality, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

  

Leadership \& QMS Governance

* Lead and develop QA staff through coaching, workload prioritization, performance feedback, and training plans.
* Own assigned QMS processes end\-to\-end, ensuring procedures are current, effective, and aligned to applicable FDA/ISO expectations.
* Promote organizational awareness of the Quality System; deliver and/or coordinate quality training, tools, and best practices.
* Establish quality objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs); compile, trend, and report quality metrics and corrective actions.
* Facilitate or contribute to management review inputs (e.g., KPI trends, audit outcomes, CAPA effectiveness, and risk status).


 Quality Operations (Change Control, CSV/Validation, Risk, CAPA, Complaints)

* Provide oversight to change control to ensure appropriate impact assessments, risk evaluations, approvals, implementation, and effectiveness checks.
* Oversee systems/process validation activities, including Computer System Validation (CSV), to ensure fit\-for\-purpose controls, compliant documentation, data integrity, and sustainable lifecycle management of regulated and quality\-impacting tools.
* Oversee risk\-based CSV activities for GxP\-relevant software, spreadsheets, databases, workflow tools, AI\-assisted applications, low\-code/no\-code solutions, and native\-built applications, including intended use assessment, risk assessment, traceability, testing, deviation handling, and validation summary reporting.
* Lead investigations for deviations, nonconformances, and complaints; ensure root cause analyses are rigorous, timely, and appropriately documented.
* Own or oversee CAPA lifecycle management, including initiation, action planning, implementation, and verification of effectiveness.
* Engineer solutions to address product, data, and process quality issues; drive continual improvement projects and standardization across teams.


Document Control \& Training

* Ensure document control processes are followed for creation, review, approval, issuance, change, and archival of controlled documents.
* Support and strengthen the training program: define role\-based curricula, coordinate training events, and monitor completion and effectiveness.
* Maintain and/or oversee maintenance of training records to ensure audit\-ready documentation.


 Audits \& Inspection Readiness

* Plan and execute internal audits; manage the annual audit program and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Host, co\-host, and support client audits; coordinate readiness activities and ensure responses are accurate, complete, and on\-time.
* Conduct or oversee supplier/vendor audits and qualification activities; ensure supplier performance is monitored and issues are escalated and resolved.


Cross\-Functional Partnership

* Partner with Operations, Clinical/Research, Product/Engineering (as applicable), and leadership to integrate quality into daily execution and decision\-making.
* Provide quality guidance during process development, supplier selection/management, and implementation of new tools or workflows, including AI\-assisted, low\-code/no\-code, and native\-built applications used in quality or operational processes.
* Partner with Product/Engineering and business stakeholders to define fit\-for\-purpose validation controls, change management expectations, and lifecycle oversight for internally developed applications and automation tools.
* Communicate quality risks clearly to stakeholders; escalate emerging issues and recommend pragmatic, compliant paths forward.

 **Position Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Biology, Chemistry, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field (required).
* 8\+ years of experience in quality supporting clinical research and/or pharmaceutical/bio

Responsible for the promotion of Walgreen’s specialty pharmacy services to targeted physicians, nurses, practice managers and other referral sources in assigned territory. Works with clients to support and understand their overall business objectives and critical success factors. Establishes and utilizes professional relationships, internally and externally, to generate support for key initiatives, challenges, and opportunities within the territory. Develops and implements strategies and tactics to consistently met or exceed quarterly sales goals. Works across highly matrixed field organization including store operations, managed markets sales, government affairs, etc.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Career\-defining. Life\-changing.**


At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**


The Sales Operations organization is looking for a talented Sales Operations Analyst to drive strategic analytics, decision intelligence, and insights for the sales and partner management teams.  



  

You’ll work cross\-functionally to frame ambiguous business questions, gather and organize complex data, and turn insights into actionable recommendations and reusable business capabilities.

**What You Will Do:**

* Deep dive into complex data sets to draw insights to help the business understand marketplace dynamics and proactively address challenges; define and build reporting infrastructure to improve visibility and performance tracking
* Identify key performance indicators and competitive insights for use by sales leaders and executives to manage the business. Establish and lead operating processes for effectively managing the organization, including actively tracking key trends in lagging/leading metrics.
* Support execution and improvement in current sales processes including goal setting, forecasting, KPI reporting and dashboard management
* Partner with sales executives on all operational and analytical requests (e.g. team restructuring, quota setting, territory planning, business performance analyses, etc.)
* Play a pivotal role in our annual strategic planning process by making recommendations in areas such as how to organize territories and improve rep productivity
* Establish strong working relationships with sales leadership, business operations, systems, and other cross\-functional teams to achieve objectives without management involvement
* Coordinate and lead efforts to drive awareness and understanding of reports \& dashboard among reps, sales leaders and executives
* Lead initiatives end to end—from problem framing and MVP prioritization through launch, measurement, and follow\-through—while creating durable organizational capacity
* Work directly with data to assess grain, definitions, quality, validation, analytical feasibility, model limitations, and monitoring so outputs are trusted and maintainable
* Build reusable decision\-intelligence platforms and operating capabilities—not one\-off dashboards or analyses—with strong governance, documentation, automation, and adoption mechanisms
* Translate ambiguous commercial and strategic opportunities into clearly defined decisions, requirements, roadmaps, and pragmatic first releases
* Support ad\-hoc projects and report requests as needed

 **What We Want To See:**

* BA/BS Degree; Degree in Business, Finance or Accounting is a plus
* 5\+ years of hands\-on analyst experience in Sales Ops
* Strong attention to detail \- you can make sense of the complex
* Creative problem\-solving skills with the ability to multi\-task and prioritize business requirements in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Obsession with finding process improvements and efficiencies to improve workflow
* Advanced MS Excel skills (i.e. pivot tables, building complex formulas)
* Experience building reusable systems, automation, governance, or operating mechanisms that remain useful beyond the initial project
* Strong ownership, integrity, and follow\-through \- including the willingness to surface inconvenient truths, acknowledge mistakes, respectfully challenge assumptions, and remain accountable after launch
* Ability to communicate complex analytical and technical concepts simply, tailor depth to the audience, make recommendations clearly, preserve material uncertainty, and influence without authority
* Strong problem\-framing and strategic judgment, including the ability to select rules, heuristics, analytics, or predictive methods based on decision value, data maturity, interpretability, implementation effort, and risk
* Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar business and technical domains quickly, test assumptions, correct misunderstandings, and apply new knowledge to consequential recommendations
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Strong service\-orientation — you know how to partner cross\-functionally
* Experience with data analytics and reporting; experience with databases/data warehouses and data querying languages such as Snowflake and SQL
* Experience using Salesforce is highly preferred
* Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong documentation skills
* Experience with Tableau
* Ability to travel, up to 15%

 **What’s in It for You:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting day one
* Generous PTO and paid holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid parental leave and family benefits
* Pet insurance discounts, cultural committees, volunteer opportunities, and more.

**Location:**


Remote \- US
Actual compensation may vary depending on job\-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.

**Estimated Pay Range**


$94,000\.00 \- $122,000\.00
As a part of our core values, we ensure an inclusive workforce. We welcome and celebrate people of all backgrounds, experiences, skills, and perspectives. iRhythm Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will consider for employment all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws.


iRhythm provides reasonable accommodations

jobs.title: RCM Customer Success Specialist 1
jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**


At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**


ModMed is hiring a customer\-focused Associate RCM Client Advisor to join our high\-performing Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) team. In this client\-facing, entry\-level role, you will provide essential tactical support across assigned client accounts by managing day\-to\-day transactional tasks, including client emails, support cases, and phone calls. The Associate RCM Client Advisor triages incoming inquiries, researches claim\-level performance issues, and educates practice office staff on best practices to ensure daily operational health and mitigate ground\-level churn risk. Working closely with Client Advisors and internal operations, you will assist with case triage, escalate trending claim issues, and help optimize client outcomes—with success measured by high CSAT scores, client referenceability, and the identification of expansion opportunities.

 **Your Role:**

* Manage incoming client emails, support cases, and transactional questions regarding charges, payments, and claims, ensuring resolution within a 48\-hour SLA.
* Conduct claim\-level denial reviews, patient balance reviews, and demographic reviews directly with client practice staff.
* Manage phone queues related to transactional questions and route inquiries to appropriate internal parties as needed.
* Identify and escalate larger claim issues, recurring trends, or contract\-related matters to the Client Advisor or appropriate functional teams for resolution.
* Oversee daily support management across approximately 20 assigned client accounts, delivering exceptional customer service to Office Managers, billers, and front\-desk staff.
* Act as a Business Systems Analyst by reviewing individual client issue examples to diagnose underlying problems using product knowledge or preparing documentation for internal subject matter experts.
* Identify repetitive workflow bottlenecks, flag recurring claim errors or internal process gaps to leadership, and suggest improvements to client\-facing documentation and training materials.
* Assist leadership and broader account teams in authoring and executing tactical risk mitigation plans for accounts identified as at\-risk.
* Identify client pain points and operational gaps that could be resolved by additional ModMed services.
* Perform additional projects and job duties as assigned.

 **Skills \& Requirements:**

* Minimum of 2 years of related experience and/or training in medical billing, healthcare business processes, or revenue cycle management (or an equivalent combination of education and experience) required.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
* Medical Billing Certification preferred.
* Solid knowledge of medical billing and coding, healthcare business processes, and a strong understanding of insurance carriers including Medicare, private HMOs, and PPOs.
* Basic Microsoft Excel skills (formulas, functions, formatting) and PowerPoint skills required.
* Detailed written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with high attention to detail.
* Strong organization and time management skills with the demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Alignment with ModMed core competencies, including Accountability, Agility, Customer Focus, Communication, and Results Driven.

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

**United States**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
* 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
* Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
* Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
* Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
* Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
* Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
* Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager - Northeast
jobs.description:
The Regional Account Manager position for the Northeast Region is responsibility for New York and surrounding states. The Regional Account Manager will exceed or achieve sales quota by delivering market share growth as well as other key performance metrics. The BDM implements the brand strategy and tactics within the assigned region and also works to accomplish call points at Hospitals, IDN systems, ASC’s, and alternate healthcare facilities. The BDM influences clinical and non\-clinical collaborators to support the use of the company’s annual subscription\-based platform solutions to include CensiTrac, ScopeTrac, LoanerLink, Analytics, and any new commercially released products by applying effective selling skills, in\-depth clinical and business expertise, CRM tool, and Assessment/return on investment tools as needed.  

  

The Regional Account Manager approaches each customer from a total account management perspective by using resources appropriately and collaborating with business partners. In addition, the Regional Account Manager accurately articulates the value proposition for the customer, including collaborators such as surgeons, clinical leaders, surgical business managers, central sterile managers and staff, IT management, Endoscopic managers, and supply chain.

**Specific Responsibilities:**

* Driving specialty product sales into assigned region including new and existing customers.
* Develop new opportunities through cold calling, marketing campaigns, ground swell activities, National Account resources, and participation in regional/national shows.
* Assisting the National Account, Channel Management, and Client Services Teams in driving unit sales volume.
* Developing and encouraging strong customer relationships, building brand loyalty, and driving current customer expansion through new product sales.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, lead, and track all sales cycle events.
* Present and demo the patient safety and business benefits of the Censis solutions through individual and committee meeting channels.
* Responsible for forecasting, monitoring, and posting sales activities within the assigned region.
* Build and maintain a clinical and technical knowledge expertise.

 **Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 5 years related sales experience selling healthcare technology applications and/or technical clinical solutions in a hospital environment.
* Experience calling on multi\-departmental hospital middle management executives at the account and IDN level.
* Experience using disciplined approach and previous experience with team selling.
* Call point experience with OR, Central Sterile, ENDO, and IT.
* Ability to travel extensively including overnights within the designated geography. Travel expectation 50% \- 70%.

 **Skills:**

* Highly developed interpersonal/communication skills with the demonstrated record of influence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication technique.
* Strong Team skills in both leading and contributing.
* Develop and drive a focused consultative sales process as an individual contributor and within a team selling environment.
* Call point expertise with OR, Central Sterile, ENDO, IT and Materials Management departments.
* Ability to develop multi\-departmental hospital middle management executive champions at the account and IDN level.
* Strong discernment and excellent negotiation, influencing, business planning, sales strategy, problem solving, decision making and time management skills.
* Must have an execution core mentality with the support of a self\-motivated desire to accept technical knowledge and build success pathways to overcome obstacles.
* Proficient with MS Office Suite, Salesforce.com CRM, WebEx, Microsoft Teams, Open Voice, and Vendor Credentialing Services.

 **Fortive Corporation Overview**


Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high\-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.


We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward\-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission\-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.


We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.


At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.


At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.


At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.


Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

**About Censis**


Censis, the first company to engineer a surgical asset management system that tracks down to the instrument and patient levels, has continually set the standards for the sterile processing industry.From the beginning, Censis has recognized the vital connection between perioperative innovation and efficiency, unparalleled customer care and improved operational performance. By continuing to invest in technology, ease of integration, education and support, Censis provides solutions that empower hospitals and healthcare providers to stay compliant and ahead of healthcare’s rapidly changing environment. With Censis, you’re positioned to start ahead and stay ahead, no matter what the future holds.

jobs.title: Program Manager, School IAQ (Southwest)
jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT**  

The Center for Green Schools (CFGS) is seeking a Regional Program Manager, School Indoor Air Quality Program (Southwest) to support the success of a five\-year, EPA\-funded effort to improve indoor air quality (IAQ) and energy efficiency in K\-12 public school systems.  

In this role, you’ll work closely with the Program Director to build off CFGS’ long\-running and successful models and provide regionally\-relevant training and coaching for K\-12 school system staff to develop plans for cleaner, healthier indoor air and energy efficiency in alignment with USGBC’s mission.  

You’ll report to the **Program Director** and be part of a **collaborative** team where your contributions will help shape impactful outcomes. You’ll work closely with colleagues at the Center for Green Schools, including other Regional Program Managers to **deliver high\-impact initiatives**. **Key Responsibilities*** Make meaningful connections with regional school system staff working on indoor air quality (IAQ) and energy efficiency, within the southwestern region of the U.S. (AZ, CA, HI, NM, NV, OK, TX)
* Develop and implement a plan for recruiting and retaining district participants, in partnership with the Program Director.
* Support K\-12 districts’ development of district\-level Energy Efficient Indoor Air Quality (EE IAQ) Management Plans by providing regionally\-relevant training (virtual and in\-person), technical assistance, educational materials, and communications.
* Travel within focal region to conduct meetings and trainings, including hosting/delivering in\-person training to reach at least fifty district staff within focal region per year. Promote resources and opportunities at regional events and conferences, including speaking and presenting, as needed.
* Build connections so that the majority of participants serve low\-income, disadvantaged, Tribal, and/or small to medium\-sized communities and districts.
* Guide an annual regional cohort of ten district staff through the School Air Quality Fellowship program, helping them navigate training, IAQ management plan development, credentialing opportunities, 1\-on\-1 coaching, and mentorship from industry experts.
* Support all logistics of the School Air Quality Fellowship program, including recruitment, coaching, training development, and the administration of travel and professional development reimbursements.
* Manage mini\-grant funding opportunity to help regional Fellows overcome barriers associated with developing and putting into practice comprehensive, district\-level EE IAQ Management Plans.
* Supervise graduate\-level interns and 1\-2 Environmental Defense Fund (EDF) Climate Corps Summer Fellows annually to support regional programming, school district outreach, and provide assistance to school districts.
* Submit quarterly progress data to the Program Director to meet EPA reporting requirements.
* Administer and analyze feedback surveys and other feedback tools with regional program participants, Fellows, and interns to ensure the program is achieving its aims.
* Working with Program Director and other Center for Green Schools staff, inform the content and/or focus of EE IAQ virtual trainings, educational materials (guides, templates, fact sheets, case studies), and media communications based on regional examples, priorities, and stories. Adapt resources for a regional audience and assist in the development and deployment, as needed.
* Collaborate effectively with the Program Director, national Center for Green Schools staff, and Regional Program Managers in other focal regions
* Attend and support logistics at the annual Green Schools Conference and national school district training.

**Experience*** Minimum 5 years of work experience required; school indoor air quality (IAQ) and energy efficiency, environmental health and safety, facility management, energy management, organizational sustainability, and/or organizational change management or a related field
* Experience with and in\-depth knowledge of day\-to\-day operational needs of public K\-12 schools or school districts and knowledge of the sustainable built environment and green building practices
* Existing K\-12 public school district connections and experiences within region
* Experience building, developing, and supporting strong, collaborative relationships with professional stakeholders
* Experience working with low\-income, disadvantaged, Tribal, and/or small to medium\-sized communities and school districts
* Strong training development and delivery, technical assistance, and coaching skills
* Ability to create or adapt in\-person and virtual professional development opportunities, educational materials, and communications content
* Proficiency in data management and analysis
* Experience leading or guiding efforts to improve indoor air quality and energy efficiency in K\-12 school systems
* Experience working with district\-level facility management, energy management, and/or environmental health staff
* Experience managing staff or interns
**Education*** Bachelor’s degree
**Technology/System(s)*** Microsoft Office products
 **Skills*** Strong organizational and project management skills
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to connect and build relationships with districts and staff interested and invested in IAQ, energy efficiency, and the mission of the Center for Green Schools
* An entrepreneurial, creative, self\-starter
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team
**Details:*** Location: Remote (Must be based in AZ, CA, OK, TX)
* Travel – upon request and approval; includes annual Green Schools Conference and approximately eight regional trips each year to conduct meetings and trainings with district staff

**Certifications*** LEED Green Associate or LEED Accredited Professional (AP) Credential preferred
**Language*** English

jobs.title: GTM Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
*This is a remote role within a global team that utilizes cutting\-edge technology to stay connected with colleagues worldwide. Occasional travel to a local office may be required for in\-person collaboration with your team, as well as for company events, team building activities, or strategic meetings.*  

  

**Being a GTM Enablement Manager at iManage Means…**


You will help Account Executives, Account Managers, and Customer Success Managers execute the customer conversations required to win, retain, and grow business. You’ll turn company priorities, market context, product positioning, and commercial processes into practical role guidance, realistic practice, manager support, and observable standards for field execution. This role spans new business, renewals, expansion, and customer value conversations, and partners with subject matter experts to build scalable programs and field resources while staying accountable for whether commercial teams can apply the guidance in their work.

**iM Responsible For…**

* Owning the commercial enablement roadmap for AEs, AMs, and CSMs, in alignment with company priorities and the GTM Enablement strategy.
* Defining what strong execution looks like for priority commercial motions, including discovery, value articulation, solution positioning, pricing, renewals, expansion, objection handling, and customer value reviews.
* Translating product, pricing, market, and process changes into role\-specific workflows, conversation guidance, examples, practice, and manager reinforcement.
* Designing and facilitating applied learning experiences such as workshops, deal\-based practice, role plays, certifications, and peer learning.
* Creating practical field resources, including playbooks, talk tracks, planning guides, scenario maps, and manager coaching tools, in partnership with Learning Design and subject matter experts.
* Providing the role\-specific commercial inputs for onboarding and ongoing readiness pathways, and partnering with the Onboarding owner to improve continuity from new\-hire readiness into in\-role performance.
* Coordinating with Strategic Programs and Learning \& Design so commercial programs are built on the same onboarding and certification pathways, stored in the shared content system with a single owner, and easy for AEs, AMs, and CSMs to find and use.
* Partnering with Sales and CX managers to embed practice, coaching, observation, and follow\-through into existing team rhythms.
* Using field feedback, manager observations, Gong or other available conversation intelligence, CRM signals, and program data to identify execution gaps and improve programs.
* Maintaining clear ownership boundaries with Product Marketing, Knowledge and Education, Revenue Operations, and field leadership, while making sure their work becomes usable in customer\-facing execution.

**iM Qualified Because I Have…**

* Experience in B2B software sales, customer success, commercial enablement, or a closely related customer\-facing role.
* Demonstrated ability to improve seller or customer success execution through practical programs rather than content production alone.
* Strong understanding of complex enterprise buying, renewal, and expansion motions; experience with consumption pricing or platform transitions is valuable.
* Credibility with customer\-facing teams and leaders, and the judgment to distinguish a knowledge problem from a skill, process, tool, or management problem.
* Ability to facilitate realistic practice, give useful feedback, and translate complex information into clear field action.
* Strong cross\-functional program management, communication, and stakeholder influence skills.
* Comfort using qualitative and quantitative evidence to assess readiness, application, and program value.

**Bonus Points If I Have…**

* Experience with modern sales enablement technology, revenue intelligence platforms, or learning management systems.
* Background in sales management or customer success leadership that informs your understanding of execution challenges.
